observed_semantics: FACT EPISODE METHOD PROCESS are explicit caller-declared kinds rather than payload-inferred semantic judgments.
Each kind has mechanically separated allowed/required reference namespaces.
FACT is explicitly not world-truth authority; EPISODE is not causal-truth authority; METHOD is not fact or transfer authority; PROCESS is not completion/effect authority.
Records bind exact MemoryLifecycleState generation/status/state digest/payload identity/provenance and fail closed on stale lifecycle binding.
The module neither reads/writes UnifiedDB nor performs retrieval ranking, model/tool invocation, effects, truth verification or completion minting.

observed_negative_tests: FACT evidence requirement without truth minting

process_distillation_adjacent_source.relevance: WP304 already preserves process candidates as non-authoritative explicit evidence with outcome/falsifier/failure-signature/transfer-condition/provenance metadata and bounded acyclic recursive composition.

primary_sources.source: ACT-R 7.30+ Reference Manual, Carnegie Mellon University
primary_sources.observed: ACT-R distinguishes declarative and procedural mechanisms; its procedural system itself separates production matching, utility/conflict resolution and production compilation. This supports different behavioral semantics for stored knowledge versus action-selection/learned procedures, but does not imply separate physical databases.

Productions are units of procedural memory with conditions and actions, providing a primary architecture example in which reusable procedure/action policy has semantics distinct from declarative chunks.

primary_sources.source: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning, NeurIPS 2023
primary_sources.observed: Reflexion stores reflective text in an episodic memory buffer and reuses it to change later decisions, demonstrating an agentic role for episode-derived memory without turning the episode itself into externally verified fact.

primary_sources.source: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior, UIST 2023
primary_sources.observed: A single memory stream can hold experiences while higher-level reflections are synthesized and dynamically retrieved for planning; storage substrate unity therefore does not require semantic-type collapse.

primary_sources.source: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models, 2023
primary_sources.observed: Voyager maintains an explicit skill library of reusable executable behaviors, supporting a distinct reusable-method/skill role separate from raw episode storage.

AWM induces reusable workflows from prior trajectories and selectively supplies them to future generations; reported relative success improvements are 24.6% on Mind2Web and 51.1% on WebArena while reducing successful WebArena steps. This supports episode-to-reusable-method transformation as a distinct operation rather than raw trajectory replay.

hypothesis: Agent memory should preserve distinct Fact/Episode/Method/Process-Policy semantics because truth/evidence, occurred-trajectory lineage, reusable-method transfer, and behavioral process/control have different update, validation and authority boundaries.
counterhypothesis: Distinct physical memory stores are unnecessary; one canonical UnifiedDB plus explicit typed records, kind-specific constraints and rebuildable retrieval projections can preserve the necessary semantic/authority boundaries with less fragmentation.

synthesis.fact_rule: FACT may bind evidence/counterevidence but memory existence must never mint world truth.
synthesis.episode_rule: EPISODE preserves event/observation/causal-lineage references but must not mint causal truth merely because an event was recorded.
synthesis.method_rule: METHOD is reusable know-how with discriminator/falsifier/failure-signature/transfer-condition metadata; method presence must not imply applicability or factual truth.
synthesis.process_policy_rule: PROCESS/POLICY controls or records behavior/checkpoints/next actions only under separate effect/capability/completion authority; memory metadata must not self-grant action authority.
synthesis.retrieval_rule: Semantic/vector overlap may rank candidates but must preserve memory_kind and authority boundary; cross-kind similarity is not type conversion.
synthesis.distillation_rule: Episode/process traces may generate Method candidates only through explicit provenance-bound distillation and later validation; raw success reports do not certify transferable methods.

specific_negative_tests_for_next_gate: retrieving an EPISODE similar to a query must not return it as FACT or satisfy a FACT-only authority predicate
retrieving a METHOD must not grant transfer applicability without explicit transfer-condition validation
retrieving PROCESS next_action metadata must not bypass capability/effect gates
distilled PROCESS pattern reported-success must remain candidate evidence and must not self-promote to METHOD authority
stale lifecycle generation must remain rejected after persistence/retrieval round-trip
architecture_delta.ledger_repair: WP303 granular ACCEPTED_AT_SCOPE evidence should be reflected in WORKPACKAGES.md and workpackages/STATE.json by the build/reconciliation lane; Trigger6 does not mutate build ledgers.

falsifiers: A held-out integration test showing equivalent safety/transfer behavior with untyped records and no kind-preserving retrieval constraints would weaken the need for typed logical separation.
Evidence that four physically separate stores reduce authority confusion without creating synchronization/duplication failure would weaken the one-UnifiedDB recommendation.

If current typed-memory persistence/retrieval already has accepted tests for all five listed cross-kind/authority negatives, the proposed next integration delta is already closed and should not be duplicated.
